Danjo Garan）是和歌山县高野山的核心宗教圣地，由空海大师于816年创建。看点包括象征佛教宇宙观的立体曼荼罗建筑群，如朱红色的根本大塔（日本首座双层多宝塔）和金堂（主殿），以及历史悠久的西塔、不动堂等国宝级木造建筑。玩法推荐清晨参拜感受静谧氛围，或参加夜间点灯活动（季节性开放），漫步青苔石阶探寻1200年历史遗迹。营业时间通常为8:30-17:00（最后入场16:30），门票500日元（含伽蓝内各堂参拜）。","picURL":"https://japantravelmate.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/2a.Danjo-Garan_SunriseHDR.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"灵宝馆","longitude":"135.5811522","latitude":"34.2112744","des":"高野山灵宝馆博物馆（Koyasan Reihokan Museum）位于日本和歌山县高野山，是一座展示佛教艺术与文化遗产的珍贵宝库。馆内收藏了超过5万件文物，包括佛像、绘画、经卷和法器，其中许多被列为国宝或重要文化财产。看点包括平安时代的精美佛像、空海大师的遗物，以及高野山真言宗的秘传法器。玩法建议结合高野山的寺庙巡礼，感受宗教与艺术的交融。 \n营业时间：8:30-17:00（最后入馆16:30），全年无休。门票价格：成人600日元，高中生350日元，中小学生250日元。","picURL":"https://www.the-kansai-guide.com/kansaiguide/data/directory/12000/11517/20211015_061110_c2210b83_w1920.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false}],[{"nameOfScence":"延历寺","longitude":"135.8411275","latitude":"35.0704634","des":"延历寺（Enryaku-ji Temple）是日本佛教天台宗的总本山，位于京都比叡山，被列为世界文化遗产。这里不仅是重要的宗教圣地，还以其壮丽的自然风光和悠久的历史文化吸引着游客。主要看点包括根本中堂、国宝殿和比叡山展望台，游客可以感受宁静的禅意，欣赏四季不同的自然美景。玩法推荐徒步登山、参拜寺庙、体验坐禅和抄经活动。营业时间为9:00至16:00，门票价格为1000日元。","picURL":"https://www.kanpai-japan.com/sites/default/files/uploads/2020/06/enryakuji-hieizan-4.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"前竹林院","longitude":"135.865799","latitude":"35.0716248","des":"前竹林院是一座历史悠久的寺庙遗址，以其宁静的庭院和传统日式建筑风格著称。游客可以欣赏到精心修剪的竹林和古朴的茶室，感受禅意氛围。最佳玩法包括漫步庭园、体验茶道文化，或在春秋季节观赏樱花与红叶。开放时间为上午9点至下午5点，最后入场时间为4:30。门票价格为成人500日元，儿童半价。这里适合喜欢历史文化和自然景观的游客前来探访。","picURL":"https://2ponderful.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/07/chikurin-in05.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"日吉大社","longitude":"135.8621864","latitude":"35.07164410000001","des":"日吉大社（Hiyoshi Taisha）位于日本滋贺县大津市，是比叡山延历寺的守护神社，拥有1200多年历史。神社以独特的“山王鸟居”和“猿神”信仰闻名，春季樱花与秋季红叶时节尤为迷人。游客可参拜主殿、欣赏古老建筑，或漫步周边自然步道。神社全年开放，参拜时间通常为日出至日落，无需门票，但部分特别区域可能收费。","picURL":"https://www.kanpai-japan.com/sites/default/files/uploads/2019/12/otsu-hiyoshi-taisha-6.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false}],[{"nameOfScence":"三井寺","longitude":"135.852861","latitude":"35.0133981","des":"园城寺（三井寺）是位于日本滋贺县大津市的天台宗寺院，拥有1200多年历史，为西国三十三所观音灵场第14番札所。主要看点包括国宝金堂、日本三大名钟之一的\"三井晚钟\"，以及从观月舞台眺望琵琶湖的绝景。游客可以体验写经、坐禅等修行活动，春季赏樱和秋季红叶季节尤为迷人。寺院全年开放，参拜时间为8:00-17:00（冬季至16:30），门票成人600日元、高中生400日元、中小学生200日元。","picURL":"https://dynamic-media-cdn.tripadvisor.com/media/photo-o/0f/a4/e8/e1/caption.jpg?w=1200&h=1200&s=1","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false}],[{"nameOfScence":"石山寺","longitude":"135.9057096","latitude":"34.9605342","des":"石山寺（Ishiyama-dera Temple）是日本滋贺县大津市的一座古老寺庙，以其悠久的历史和美丽的自然景观而闻名。看点包括寺内的本堂，据传是紫式部创作《源氏物语》的灵感之地，以及秋季的红叶和春季的樱花，景色十分迷人。玩法推荐参观寺内的文化财，漫步于宁静的庭园，感受历史与自然的和谐。营业时间通常为8:30至16:30，门票价格为成人600日元，儿童300日元。","picURL":"https://japanization.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/ishiyama-dera-temple.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false}]]},{"uid":"1","tripName":"我的盛京周末","domestic":1,"designer":"DevilDI","city":"沈阳","country":"中国","tags":"文化/古都","cover":"https://youimg1.c-ctrip.com/target/100k0o000000fccbpCFC8.jpg","detail":[[{"nameOfScence":"沈阳故宫","longitude":"123.455676","latitude":"41.798386","des":"是的，沈阳也有故宫，就是小点","picURL":"https://ts1.cn.mm.bing.net/th/id/R-C.22c4414a99d747d1d6c0e450821c4c12?rik=eJ1q8wBSx6%2bofA&riu=http%3a%2f%2fimg95.699pic.com%2fphoto%2f50108%2f7513.jpg_wh860.jpg&ehk=Y1%2bDNBhRGEIEly1Tkw2JT9Hd%2beWRULSmve2UWJ1Whrw%3d&risl=&pid=ImgRaw&r=0","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"大帅府","longitude":"123.457791","latitude":"41.794058","des":"张作霖故居，全沈阳最有味道的地方，游览的时候一定要有讲解！","picURL":"https://tse2-mm.cn.bing.net/th/id/OIP-C.t5dwJK7umsb31y3dBFLt-gEsDh?pid=ImgDet&rs=1","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false}],[{"nameOfScence":"1905文创园","longitude":"123.382444","latitude":"41.812451","des":"沈阳798，每周五会有集市，值得一逛！","picURL":"https://img1.qunarzz.com/travel/d8/1802/93/5f608cb0fc8a4bb5.jpg_r_480x360x95_b4d63486.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"918历史博物馆","longitude":"123.467533","latitude":"41.836397","des":"勿忘国耻918","picURL":"https://so1.360tres.com/t01121d5d5c3ead7f18.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false}]]},{"uid":"6","tripName":"秘境甘南","domestic":1,"designer":"DevilDI","city":"兰州/甘南","country":"中国","tags":"草原/藏传佛教/风景","cover":"https://n.sinaimg.cn/sinacn20106/300/w1620h1080/20190222/60d7-htknpmh2438974.jpg","detail":[[{"nameOfScence":"甘肃省博物馆","longitude":"103.774625","latitude":"36.066606","des":"这里是感受丝绸之路文化的好地方，有镇馆之宝-马踏飞燕。记得把临时展厅放在第一位！博物馆周一关门，门票免费！","picURL":"https://tse2-mm.cn.bing.net/th/id/OIP-C.gqB38sYrCCtqUPkhK_A-tgHaE7?pid=ImgDet&rs=1","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"西关清真大寺","longitude":"103.811824","latitude":"36.059655","des":"从博物馆出来，步行大约4公里，就到了此行第二站：西关清真大寺。其创建于明万历年间，清康熙、雍正年间曾两次重修，建筑共4层，进入需着长衣长裤，记得遵守穆斯林的习俗哟！","picURL":"https://youimg1.c-ctrip.com/target/100a14000000w8x2mDFE5.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"黄河铁桥","longitude":"103.8166","latitude":"36.065529","des":"从清真寺出来，沿路走到黄河铁桥，此桥为兰州城市地标，始建于1906年。从南岸穿桥到北岸，打卡即可！","picURL":"https://th.bing.com/th/id/R.54aa0694e56e6db2f6da404ec37b71bf?rik=byn%2fJGHQjcYUDA&riu=http%3a%2f%2fimg.pconline.com.cn%2fimages%2fphotoblog%2f7%2f0%2f8%2f8%2f7088007%2f20092%2f4%2f1233761743150.jpg&ehk=4hGdAktUq2sXB0Zb7d%2b1kpKIYyweGYEDE9gI2emMDTU%3d&risl=&pid=ImgRaw&r=0","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"白塔山公园","longitude":"103.811794","latitude":"36.06946","des":"过了铁桥就是白塔山公园，沿路上山，会看见许多典型的中式风格建筑，可以俯瞰黄河风景，当然也可以找个傍晚看日落！","picURL":"https://img1.qunarzz.com/travel/d0/1706/25/b8ce5e729551c4b5.jpg_480x360x95_102ac085.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"正宁路小吃夜市","longitude":"103.820017","latitude":"36.053571","des":"晚上记得来也是吃点特产，鸡蛋醪糟，灰豆子，杏皮水，甜醅子...","picURL":"https://tse3-mm.cn.bing.net/th/id/OIP-C._B5LCJ736oyQ2FyzmHaGLAHaFN?pid=ImgDet&rs=1","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false}],[{"nameOfScence":"拉卜楞寺","longitude":"102.50966","latitude":"35.192953","des":"第二天，租好车，甘南自驾之旅正式启航！首站直奔拉卜楞寺，高速国道均可，因为风景真的在路上！拉卜楞寺，世界最大藏传佛教学府，有世界最长的转经筒道，拉卜楞寺规模宏大，随便逛就可以了，记得寺庙正中的贡唐宝塔可以登顶，边上半山腰是极好的取景地。游览约2个小时后，驱车夏河县城住宿！","picURL":"https://ts1.cn.mm.bing.net/th/id/R-C.88492f768a1ed2d063671688eecd2f4c?rik=HDgtZETPy8M0UA&riu=http%3a%2f%2fimg.pconline.com.cn%2fimages%2fupload%2fupc%2ftx%2fphotoblog%2f1207%2f12%2fc1%2f12307296_12307296_1342051634703.jpg&ehk=MJiVUa8lYfpTi7WzGH%2b46ovjFtuTQiR5f3gVqRbUD28%3d&risl=&pid=ImgRaw&r=0","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false}],[{"nameOfScence":"甘加秘境","longitude":"102.560235","latitude":"35.393046","des":"早饭后的第一站，整个景区130多平方公里，景区以自然风光为主，主要景点有八角古城、白石崖等，","picURL":"https://tse3-mm.cn.bing.net/th/id/OIP-C.Y8Q9pvLips-9ZfOf3wVt2gAAAA?pid=ImgDet&rs=1","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"桑科草原","longitude":"102.569736","latitude":"35.00305","des":"桑科草原属于草甸草原，平均海拔在3000米以上，草原面积达70平方公里，是甘南藏族自治州的主要畜牧业基地之一。这里人口少面积大，仅有4000多牧民，草原却辽阔无际，是一处极为宝贵的自然旅游景区。","picURL":"https://img.pconline.com.cn/images/upload/upc/tx/itbbs/1408/04/c5/37052198_1407154086032_mthumb.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"郭莽湿地","longitude":"102.312689","latitude":"34.310373","des":"路上会路过的一个开放式景点，开车经过时，一不小心可能会错过。穿过小贩的档口后，沿着长长的木栈道，就可以到达郭莽湿地观景台。一句话概括：草原大美之境。","picURL":"https://tse4-mm.cn.bing.net/th/id/OIP-C.UvKcKv-JZcDABt3P7Oax3gHaEC?pid=ImgDet&rs=1","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"尕海湖","longitude":"102.326438","latitude":"34.237005","des":"继续驱车，路过尕海湖：甘南第一大湖。你有可能看到成群的牛羊和飞鸟，当然木栈道是必不可少的！","picURL":"https://youimg1.c-ctrip.com/target/100h1900000161vx4E380.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"郎木寺镇","longitude":"102.632929","latitude":"34.092557","des":"郎木寺镇是甘肃甘南藏族自治州碌曲县和四川阿坝藏族羌族自治州若尔盖县共同下辖的一个小镇，白龙江穿镇而过。值得一去的是格尔底寺，当晚再次留宿。","picURL":"https://ts1.cn.mm.bing.net/th/id/R-C.ec2604ddd558614d02e9593f2d87d846?rik=3r3A1tKom8d1rA&riu=http%3a%2f%2fcc1.cache.cdqss.com%2fphotochengdu%2fattachment%2fforum%2f201303%2f06%2f093713yvipqclpi82lmcm3.jpg&ehk=nrriIlzNcbLb5ET0fRbWY9lMr%2ffKzpGp6ROQ1s%2fekbY%3d&risl=&pid=ImgRaw&r=0","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"纳摩峡谷（选）","longitude":"102.609791","latitude":"34.081347","des":"徒步的好地方，沿着白龙江往上游走，会路过仙女洞，一路探索，会到达白龙江的源头。如果时间允许的话，一定要去！","picURL":"https://17749730.s21i.faiusr.com/2/ABUIABACGAAgzfjX4wUo0dT5gQQwhAc4wQQ.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false}],[{"nameOfScence":"扎尕那","longitude":"103.19622","latitude":"34.235821","des":"四个字总结：户外天堂！这里有木栈道线路，也可以玩深度穿越，也可以骑马自驾。仙女滩一定要去，一定要在第二天的清晨去观景台看薄雾中的扎尕那！","picURL":"https://img1.qunarzz.com/travel/d0/1709/a7/ef5a58fedbda0db5.jpg?ver=1","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false}],[{"nameOfScence":"米拉日巴佛阁","longitude":"102.912675","latitude":"35.006466","des":"甘南之旅的最后一站，今天以返程自驾为主，米拉日巴佛阁就在回程的路上。楼高共九层，每一层都有不同的主题，如果时间充裕，可以慢慢细细地逛！","picURL":"https://youimg1.c-ctrip.com/target/10080q000000gn4q08B2F.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false}]]},{"uid":"7","tripName":"海岛日记","domestic":1,"designer":"DevilDI","city":"烟台","country":"中国","tags":"周末/海边","cover":"https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-203e7bca242965c5157c01d4914a012e_720w.jpg?source=172ae18b","detail":[[{"nameOfScence":"芝罘仙境—朝阳街","longitude":"121.401775","latitude":"37.542567","des":"旅程从朝阳街开始，街不长，直通烟台山，有很多网红打卡点，理想书店值得一去！","picURL":"https://mir-s3-cdn-cf.behance.net/project_modules/max_1200/e7943f120559727.60b47b2f679a7.png","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"烟台山","longitude":"121.402332","latitude":"37.546603","des":"烟台山，是烟台市的标志性景区，山、海、城、港连为一体的特色观唯此独有；烟台山有着600多年的沧桑历史，是这座城市历史重要发祥地和象征，有保存完整的近代外国领事馆群，可登最高点灯塔，也可下到海边礁石，不能错过！","picURL":"https://tr-osdcp.qunarzz.com/tr-osd-tr-space/img/7e6fbffdebfa8e396ac2025b3be28a78.jpg_r_680x382x95_11689e03.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"烟台美术博物馆","longitude":"121.407667","latitude":"37.542633","des":"从烟台山出来，沿着海岸走，就是这座网红博物馆了，有非常有特色的黑色旋转楼梯，可以进来一逛","picURL":"https://www.ytctam.com/uploadfile/2016/1003/20161003030352330.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"海岛日记(第一海水浴场店)","longitude":"121.413387","latitude":"37.539153","des":"从博物馆出来，沿着海边走，一定不会错过这个坐落于海边的网红咖啡厅，正好走累了，可以点上一杯竹筒奶茶，吹吹风，拍拍照","picURL":"https://sns-img-hw.xhscdn.com/c7f44c04-877b-5957-2ee2-c78641761850?imageView2/2/w/1920/format/webp|imageMogr2/strip","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"月亮湾","longitude":"121.433833","latitude":"37.535053","des":"同样位于滨海路上，可以浅浅地逛上一逛","picURL":"https://sns-img-qc.xhscdn.com/1000g0082bop7kiah40605niacvrg9c2rcdftcpo?imageView2/2/w/1920/format/webp|imageMogr2/strip","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"海昌渔人码头","longitude":"121.452367","latitude":"37.519283","des":"去寻找千与千寻的铁轨吧！","picURL":"https://sns-img-qc.xhscdn.com/1000g0082cqhvkh2h00004aecgjuakcme1u3jpqo?imageView2/2/w/1920/format/webp|imageMogr2/strip","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"芝罘湾广场","longitude":"121.393162","latitude":"37.544389","des":"是一个特别适合拍照的商业风情街，推荐晚上去！","picURL":"https://sns-img-qc.xhscdn.com/8f642a4a-306d-db58-a945-23e6c2c2bfe1?imageView2/2/w/1920/format/webp|imageMogr2/strip","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"所城里大街","longitude":"121.40063","latitude":"37.536279","des":"一段仿古大街，适合回酒店的路上顺便去看看","picURL":"https://ts1.cn.mm.bing.net/th/id/R-C.4b955fb0284e09dca90574555e063d55?rik=hax63kvC%2bAIOiA&riu=http%3a%2f%2fimg.jiaodong.net%2fpic%2f003%2f007%2f868%2f00300786869_9f34e93b.jpg&ehk=3LkdBUMTzsPGqE3Kk0FuwO4pWmxw6WFVMmw1jdKUNWk%3d&risl=&pid=ImgRaw&r=0","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false}],[{"nameOfScence":"养马岛","longitude":"121.61166","latitude":"37.45382","des":"被称为“东方夏威夷”，租车自驾最佳，逆时针环岛，会看到海水浴场，海边栈道等，可以随时停车随时游览","picURL":"https://youimg1.c-ctrip.com/target/10080i0000009jwbz358C.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"蓬莱阁","longitude":"120.754559","latitude":"37.824651","des":"蓬莱阁，地处丹崖山上，始建于北宋嘉祐六年（1061年），历代屡加修葺，没有经过重建，至今仍保持北宋原貌；因“八仙过海”传说和“海市蜃楼”奇观而闻名四海，“蓬莱十大景”中有八景位于蓬莱阁；自古有“人间仙境”之美誉，与湖南岳阳岳阳楼、江西南昌滕王阁、湖北武汉黄鹤楼并称为“中国四大名楼”、是“中国十大历史文化名楼”之一，世称“江北第一阁”。","picURL":"https://ts1.cn.mm.bing.net/th/id/R-C.7035b4cd8038fb75f1cd277ee2094fe0?rik=Fh0MwogH3nd46A&riu=http%3a%2f%2fwww.99809.com%2fLogin%2fadmin%2fattached%2fimage%2f20200910%2f20200910163727_92031.jpg&ehk=zwEgVlUAYZcOT9nNw17FJ6sCVuc68FGDOagkUzNmTrI%3d&risl=&pid=ImgRaw&r=0","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false}]]},{"uid":"8","tripName":"烟火人间","domestic":1,"designer":"DevilDI","city":"福州/泉州","country":"中国","tags":"长假/古迹/春节","cover":"https://pic3.zhimg.com/v2-67d87e289625dc3aadd1922b59709cc3_1200x500.jpg","detail":[[{"nameOfScence":"三坊七巷","longitude":"119.296356","latitude":"26.085167","des":"三坊七巷自晋代发轫，于唐五代形成，到明清鼎盛，为国内现存规模较大、保护较为完整的历史文化街区，有“中国城市里坊制度活化石”和“中国明清建筑博物馆”的美称，街中有心形大榕树，非常值得一去。","picURL":"https://img95.699pic.com/photo/50117/6902.jpg_wh860.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"林则徐纪念馆","longitude":"119.297274","latitude":"26.078369","des":"“苟利国家生死以，岂因祸福避趋之”。林则徐纪念馆是“福州古厝”的典型代表。全年免费对外开放，值得一去","picURL":"https://youimg1.c-ctrip.com/target/100s0y000000mmsyuEFEE.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"冶山春秋园","longitude":"119.298785","latitude":"26.096281","des":"是一所春秋时期文化遗址——冶山命名的公园。有非常厚重的历史感，院内有众多碑文和遗址印记。","picURL":"https://ts1.cn.mm.bing.net/th/id/R-C.d09f8f49d7127d46e13eb45405a607a0?rik=w6evoukR33BJqg&riu=http%3a%2f%2fimg1.qunarzz.com%2ftravel%2fpoi%2f201303%2f14%2f699b82be0616800addb12cfb.jpg_r_1024x683x95_683db873.jpg&ehk=ozYQddPnd6VKQWiv8hXoJU700OzPaHV6tbNCC5wmsqk%3d&risl=&pid=ImgRaw&r=0","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"福道","longitude":"119.266247","latitude":"26.086481","des":"被国家地理评为全球最美步道的福道果然名不虚传！福道全长19km，共有10个出入口，对于普通旅行者，选择其中一段步行，感受凌空走在山林之间，欣赏这座被绿植覆盖的城市最为美妙~推荐从3号口进的，5号口出。","picURL":"https://th.bing.com/th/id/OIP.d3nOEdmt4Bf-VZTGbXmdUQHaE7?rs=1&pid=ImgDetMain","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false}],[{"nameOfScence":"上下杭","longitude":"119.305036","latitude":"26.053361","des":"闽商的发源地，以清末民初时代的建筑为主，古色古香的地方，比较适合拍照打卡","picURL":"https://tr-osdcp.qunarzz.com/tr-osd-tr-space/img/f0a25cc1ad5c9edcb2acf923fedd59e1.jpg?ver=1","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"青年会","longitude":"119.310386","latitude":"26.050359","des":"这个广场可以说真的超级适合拍照打卡！","picURL":"https://img1.fjdaily.com/app/images/2022-06/16/2645182a-f72c-4309-a999-a994975a473b.jpg.2","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"天主堂","longitude":"119.324802","latitude":"26.048116","des":"始建于清同治三年(1864年)，民国22年(1933年)重建，哥特式建筑。主堂北端，建有20多米高的钟楼，楼顶竖立近3米高的十字架。昔时钟楼报时声扬十余里，号称“江南第一大堂”","picURL":"https://youimg1.c-ctrip.com/target/10050s000000i3x8qFD43.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"烟台山公园","longitude":"119.315527","latitude":"26.044964","des":"烟台山公园现有面积约2.11公顷，在仓前山梅坞顶，临江而倚，地势扼要。史书载，元朝山上筑有炮垒，以扼闽江；明清两代复置烟台，作为报警御敌之用，故名烟台山","picURL":"https://p1-q.mafengwo.net/s18/M00/54/36/CoUBYGCuNXGAC4rlAC8N6ozrZCk608.jpg?imageMogr2%2Fthumbnail%2F%21690x450r%2Fgravity%2FCenter%2Fcrop%2F%21690x450%2Fquality%2F90%7Cwatermark%2F1%2Fimage%2FaHR0cDovL21mdy1mYXN0ZGZzLTEyNTgyOTUzNjUuY29zLmFwLWJlaWppbmcubXlxY2xvdWQuY29tL3MxMS9NMDAvNDQvOUIvd0tnQkVGc1A1UnlBRHY3cEFBQUhaWlVQUmxROTkwLnBuZw%3D%3D%2Fgravity%2FSouthEast%2Fdx%2F10%2Fdy%2F11","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"烟台山商业街区","longitude":"119.310284","latitude":"26.043689","des":"全福州最具活力的地方，有很多历史建筑，跟着路标随便逛即可","picURL":"https://tr-osdcp.qunarzz.com/tr-osd-tr-space/img/afbf4eb17984dfb9135f5bcf4053e782.jpg_r_640x826x70_743cea9e.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false}],[{"nameOfScence":"泉州开元寺","longitude":"118.585519","latitude":"24.914168","des":"开元寺始创于唐初，是宋元时期泉州规模最大、官方地位最突出的佛教寺院。现存主要庙宇系明、清两代修建，寺内东西两塔耸立其中，是泉州的象征","picURL":"https://ts1.cn.mm.bing.net/th/id/R-C.2d3b2612e2ed0d44a48b6687a16ab277?rik=srgoilJ79yKGbg&riu=http%3a%2f%2fp2.ifengimg.com%2fhaina%2f2016_42%2f4a19e44b1e7d7de_w990_h660.jpg&ehk=3LTr8R%2f2%2bxaF6jzAm7HA%2fuxmTFZLYEPYJFwLt50XGh0%3d&risl=&pid=ImgRaw&r=0","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"泉州西街","longitude":"118.585013","latitude":"24.913284","des":"早在宋朝，它就已经象征了泉州的繁荣，它还是泉州市区保存最完整的古街区，保留着大量具有历史原貌的建筑；两边都是店铺，尽头是有名的西街钟楼","picURL":"https://img1.qunarzz.com/travel/poi/1603/88/b76879c4d4cb96f7.jpg_r_640x426x70_7af602c5.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"觅鲤文创园","longitude":"118.590872","latitude":"24.909153","des":"去打卡吧","picURL":"https://flight-feed.qunarzz.com/as3/271/image/poi_vishnu/ebcb4d81-2099-436c-8273-17e0fa1b6837.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"承天禅寺","longitude":"118.594937","latitude":"24.908439","des":"承天寺没那么商业化，也没有那么多游客，有一种大隐隐于市、闹中取静的感觉，寺内的十奇景有“城市山林”的称号","picURL":"https://img1.qunarzz.com/travel/d3/1610/48/07bfdb39ff60dfb5.jpg_r_480x360x95_864e8550.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"文庙","longitude":"118.590096","latitude":"24.905954","des":"文庙始建于唐开元末年，其建筑规模宏大，是集宋、元、明、清四朝代的建筑形式的孔庙建筑群；历史悠久，规制完整，气势宏大，文化内涵丰厚，是东南地区名闻遐迩的最大的文庙建筑群；布局匀称，建筑优美，造型独特，是宋代中原文化和闽南古建筑艺术的有机结合","picURL":"https://youimg1.c-ctrip.com/target/100u180000013rxsc0D08.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"金鱼巷","longitude":"118.587959","latitude":"24.905838","des":"蛮有特色的一条街，在文庙附近","picURL":"https://p9.itc.cn/q_70/images03/20220804/3cdc86221a024bf4bb855baa3113dbab.jpeg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false}],[{"nameOfScence":"天后宫","longitude":"118.588755","latitude":"24.895235","des":"泉州天后宫，位于泉州市区南门天后路一号，始建宋庆元二年（公元1196年），最早称“娘妈宫”，其是所有妈祖庙中现存建筑规模最大，保存最好，仍保留一些宋代构件和明清时代木构。","picURL":"https://img95.699pic.com/photo/50019/2175.jpg_wh860.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"通淮关岳庙","longitude":"118.592796","latitude":"24.901753","des":"主祀关羽,民国三年(1914年)增祀岳飞，是祭祀文(孔子)武（关羽）圣的著也是福建省现存规模最大的武庙。香火不是一般的旺","picURL":"https://ts1.cn.mm.bing.net/th/id/R-C.9c4262d1bc417bce17b8ba33c0d45e8a?rik=83p7Xa7%2bNb%2bKsQ&riu=http%3a%2f%2fyouimg1.c-ctrip.com%2ftarget%2ffd%2ftg%2fg4%2fM08%2fC6%2f14%2fCggYHFX72nSAWOLoAAL1PKXOh7E589.jpg&ehk=3ddoSNvA5Ngv0%2b7e%2fL7HGVd1W4l6pv2UqnCRMS85v28%3d&risl=&pid=ImgRaw&r=0","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"清净古寺","longitude":"118.591483","latitude":"24.902682","des":"我国现存最早的一处伊斯兰教建筑","picURL":"https://youimg1.c-ctrip.com/target/1004180000013qy5aDC03.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"洛阳桥","longitude":"118.679228","latitude":"24.949319","des":"洛阳桥，是现存最早的跨海梁式石桥，素有“海内第一桥”之誉，是古代“四大名桥”之一。千万要去看看","picURL":"https://sns-img-qc.xhscdn.com/edb9a65a-d831-5daf-fc31-1637b39e3297?imageView2/2/w/1920/format/webp|imageMogr2/strip","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false}]]},{"uid":"10","tripName":"乐园巡游—香港迪士尼","domestic":1,"designer":"DevilDI","city":"澳门/香港","country":"中国","tags":"特种兵/度假/乐园","cover":"https://ts1.cn.mm.bing.net/th/id/R-C.770861e4fb3909ffe006560caebe62bd?rik=lX8mcWOnr0SV9A&riu=http%3a%2f%2fn.sinaimg.cn%2ftranslate%2f20171017%2fIMKt-fymvkax7509726.jpg&ehk=kd2t8xNIGZkgXEqiIcqlMaqVBFdYtYxsCXLuCgEMZJI%3d&risl=&pid=ImgRaw&r=0&sres=1&sresct=1","detail":[[{"nameOfScence":"龙环葡韵","longitude":"113.565177","latitude":"22.151177","des":"澳门最具代表性的葡萄牙殖民时期建筑群，同时也是“澳门八景”之一。景区包括住宅式博物馆、嘉模教堂、凼仔图书馆、凼仔市政花园和十字花园。住宅式博物馆又分为土生葡人之家、海岛之家、葡萄牙地区之家、展览馆、迎宾馆，每个馆都展览着不同类别的珍贵照片文物，可以在此感受土生葡人在澳门的那段历史。每周一闭馆","picURL":"https://youimg1.c-ctrip.com/target/100l190000016vmcgDA27.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"c 东西汇聚区、励骏码头，设有酒店、游乐场，还有许多购物场所，是凹造型拍照和看海景的好去处","picURL":"https://ts1.cn.mm.bing.net/th/id/R-C.df549e1772a6654f933a352c242a5d63?rik=Ukjf5c4Sr1TbfQ&riu=http%3a%2f%2fimg8.ppsj.com.cn%2f217%2f2176%2fw121083768.jpg&ehk=SMVSK71TR2qnuSJm6w1IT7X3qIPuw8CckTml3LhcdFs%3d&risl=&pid=ImgRaw&r=0&sres=1&sresct=1","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"威尼斯人","longitude":"113.566661","latitude":"22.145351","des":"汇集了威尼斯酒店、威尼斯人剧院、圣马可广场、大运河购物中心。作为澳门比较知名的地标景点之一，除了拍照也是购物的好场所","picURL":"https://ts1.cn.mm.bing.net/th/id/R-C.7b48cb600c833a4f548e9f29e19f8d44?rik=f1tSIpkJ7LcZEw&riu=http%3a%2f%2fimages.china.cn%2fattachement%2fjpg%2fsite1000%2f20091117%2f0019b91edeeb0c6c575608.jpg&ehk=VeiBzqR8eBMt8O%2fWMGGRZjlfo3cXfRZ63iU854vjavg%3d&risl=&pid=ImgRaw&r=0","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false}],[{"nameOfScence":"路环圣方济各圣堂","longitude":"113.556564","latitude":"22.113997","des":"路环圣方济各圣堂位于路环岛的计旦奴街，教堂不大，形状为澳门一般教堂的巴罗克式建筑特色。教堂的外观为白色，窗户为椭圆形，有一座钟楼","picURL":"https://tr-osdcp.qunarzz.com/tr-osd-tr-space/img/3abff74b784d79877dd972ca0fed6572.jpg_480x360x95_f9a1efcf.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"十月初五马路","longitude":"113.555852","latitude":"22.113133","des":"这条街有各种颜色的房子，也有独居特色的餐厅，非常适合拍照。沿着马路走就可以到圣方济各教堂","picURL":"https://youimg1.c-ctrip.com/target/100f14000000wl11bA1E1.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"黑沙海滩","longitude":"113.575635","latitude":"22.118062","des":"沙滩宽约1公里，沙的特色在于黝黑，海沙均匀，幼滑的细沙，故有黑沙海滩之名。黑色的细沙是由于海洋特定环境形成的带黑的次生矿海绿石所致。“海绿石” 受海流影响，被搬至近岸，再经风浪携带到海滩，使原来洁白明净的白沙滩，变成了迷人神秘的黑沙滩。每逢假日周末盛夏时节，黑沙海滩游人如鲫，热闹非常。黑沙海滩是澳门地区最大的天然海滩","picURL":"https://img95.699pic.com/photo/50111/6898.jpg_wh860.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"花墟道","longitude":"114.175665","latitude":"22.322272","des":"旺角花墟道简称花墟，是香港花草盆栽集中地，售卖的花卉种类、数量极多，是全香港之冠","picURL":"https://tse3-mm.cn.bing.net/th/id/OIP-C.ToRD5XZA-3LbVNPyCncAeAAAAA?pid=ImgDet&rs=1","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"通菜街","longitude":"114.17478","latitude":"22.320211","des":"通菜街是香港油尖旺区的一条著名道路，位于旺角弥敦道之东，北至界限街，南至登打士街。现时这条街道是香港著名的购物区之一。","picURL":"https://youimg1.c-ctrip.com/target/100e0z000000mrik4C6E0.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"金鱼街","longitude":"114.175229","latitude":"22.318418","des":"金鱼街位于中国香港的油尖旺区，是旺角的一个观光购物地点。该地点的位置为通菜街贯穿旺角道至水渠街、太子道西之一段。1950年代起，香港九广东铁旺角站附近有很多小贩贩卖金鱼和红虫，其后转至界限街及花墟道一带。1970年代中期，金鱼商贩选择了旺角道至水渠街的一段通菜街作为售卖地点。由于他们售卖金鱼为主，所以俗称金鱼街","picURL":"https://tse3-mm.cn.bing.net/th/id/OIP-C.uQaWytY1iDTbNBxAw0uQLAHaFj?pid=ImgDet&rs=1","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"西洋菜南街","longitude":"114.17498","latitude":"22.3164","des":"西洋菜街是一个集美食、文化和历史于一身的地方，绝对值得一去","picURL":"https://tse1-mm.cn.bing.net/th/id/OIP-C.Z-4cEB9rhZJGNuuIICYAdgHaE6?pid=ImgDet&rs=1","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"波鞋街","longitude":"114.176678","latitude":"22.314049","des":"整段波鞋街约500米长，约有150多间售卖运动鞋和运动用品的店铺。因为粤语将运动鞋称为「波鞋」，波鞋街因而得名，注意A货哦","picURL":"https://ts1.cn.mm.bing.net/th/id/R-C.5d53218976f673c46586395a6d70f2d4?rik=Ga5TXRI3W3B79g&pid=ImgRaw&r=0","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"上海街","longitude":"114.174262","latitude":"22.310926","des":"以百年唐楼著称","picURL":"https://ts1.cn.mm.bing.net/th/id/R-C.4cc236aae9e1fc99926ce38a937ff46e?rik=fW31PSGscZu3BA&riu=http%3a%2f%2fwww.locpg Tung Street），俗称喜帖街（囍帖街）或印刷街，位于香港岛湾仔区，是中国香港的著名印刷品制作及门市集中地，尤其以印刷喜帖著名","picURL":"https://img1.qunarzz.com/travel/d5/1607/4f/77314d47b19568b6.jpg_r_720x480x95_52b624b8.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"春园街","longitude":"114.177667","latitude":"22.272756","des":"在春園街西南端盡頭是一條長長的樓梯，也是電影取景地。人們從這里上上下下、來來往往、相遇、相別離","picURL":"https://sns-img-hw.xhscdn.net/ab2cf1fd-1bfd-4a41-2f64-708ed96394ab?imageView2/2/h/1920/format/webp|imageMogr2/strip","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"WE哗蓝屋湾仔蓝屋","longitude":"114.179086","latitude":"22.271159","des":"原来是一家武馆，后改成医馆，蓝色外墙和远处的黄色外墙房子相得益彰，拍出来很好看","picURL":"https://ts1.cn.mm.bing.net/th/id/R-C.773a144efe795bafa170dc6cbadfa8fc?rik=nIGWvJWt1sz5ig&riu=http%3a%2f%2fwww.you1688.com%2fWebEditor%2fuploadfile%2f20180601102811596.jpg&ehk=%2fAl5Rr9jHfPFW9BPFFuI1aq%2blefl2iRjkawwW6mJavA%3d&risl=&pid=ImgRaw&r=0","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"白沙道","longitude":"114.188925","latitude":"22.276261","des":"来到了购物天堂铜锣湾，请放肆血拼吧","picURL":"https://www.wingleung.me/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/IMG_2459-1200x900.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"兰桂坊","longitude":"114.160537","latitude":"22.278239","des":"由德己立街、威灵顿街、云咸街、安里、仁寿里及荣华里构成的一个聚集大小酒吧与餐馆的中高档消费区，深受年轻一代、游客的欢迎，是香港的特色旅游景点之一。兰桂坊酒吧街缘起于20世纪70年代初期，港府在中西区开始进行市区重建。当时一位意大利籍商人在这里开设了一间意大利服装店及餐厅。部份在中环上班的“优皮士”，下班后想找一个地方谈天，这家餐厅便成为他们欢乐时光的聚脚处。其后，兰桂坊渐渐成为一处有品位的消闲之地，酒吧、食肆及娱乐场所越开越多","picURL":"https://img1.qunarzz.com/travel/poi/201407/24/4ea6858df5c8c694c8d65eac.jpg_480x360x95_a6e7b182.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false}],[{"nameOfScence":"香港迪士尼乐园","longitude":"114.047326","latitude":"22.309841","des":"港迪是全球第五座、亚洲第二座、中国第一座迪士尼乐园。乐园分为7个主题园区，分别为美国小镇大街、探险世界、幻想世界、明日世界、玩具总动员大本营、灰熊山谷和迷离庄园，其中灰熊山谷和迷离庄园为全球独有。园区内设有主题游乐设施、娱乐表演、互动体验、餐饮服务、商品店铺及小食亭。此外，乐园每天晚上会呈献巡游表演节目及烟花汇演","picURL":"https://ts1.cn.mm.bing.net/th/id/R-C.ac4fcf9516120ceae007023eeff125b4?rik=OdyHcU1TX0XVOQ&riu=http%3a%2f%2fwww.xhly20.com%2ffiles%2f2017-9%2f20170901112353147607.jpg&ehk=NypwgdIOKuCLAf1k80%2bpS0cVtc4970s%2bBP0GSbvrD24%3d&risl=&pid=ImgRaw&r=0","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false}]]},{"uid":"11","tripName":"特种兵在南京","domestic":1,"designer":"DevilDI","city":"南京","country":"中国","tags":"周末/特种兵/文化","cover":"","detail":[[{"nameOfScence":"南京博物院","longitude":"118.825064","latitude":"32.040802","des":"南京必打卡。中国三大博物馆之一，珍贵文物仅次于故宫博物院，历史观、特展馆、民国馆重点参观。一定一定要提前预约。博物院周一闭馆","picURL":"https://ts1.cn.mm.bing.net/th/id/R-C.1ba607e00429130409053e79d4031a5d?rik=9OTT%2bttm9%2fCZZg&riu=http%3a%2f%2fpic.baike.soso.com%2fp%2f20140514%2f20140514102413-455075770.jpg&ehk=nqK6a2wNpCYXCItM9ShJ1zXY2yPpHFXb3qko8ZHNhzo%3d&risl=&pid=ImgRaw&r=0","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"中山陵","longitude":"118.854097","latitude":"32.054508","des":"位于钟山风景名胜区内，是中国近代伟大的民主革命先行者孙中山先生的陵寝及其附属纪念建筑群，陵寝面积8万余平方米，于1926年春动工，至1929年夏建成。中山陵前临平川，背拥青嶂，东毗灵谷寺，西邻明孝陵，整个建筑群依山势而建，由南往北沿中轴线逐渐升高，主要建筑有博爱坊、墓道、陵门、石阶、碑亭、祭堂和墓室等，排列在一条中轴线上，体现了中国传统建筑的风格，从空中往下看，像一座平卧在绿绒毯上的“自由钟”。可乘坐景区观光车前往（10元1次），也可以步行顺道打卡梧桐大道，中山陵免费但需要提前预约","picURL":"https://youimg1.c-ctrip.com/target/100h11000000ripuy3B79_D_10000_1200.jpg?proc=autoorient","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"南京音乐台","longitude":"118.855382","latitude":"32.055096","des":"紧挨着中山陵，门票10元，看点是一群鸽子同时起飞的场景","picURL":"https://ts1.cn.mm.bing.net/th/id/R-C.7ee900c40c98e6e66d43b2b2faf1c327?rik=6hrBjN3aImgKSw&riu=http%3a%2f%2fyouimg1.c-ctrip.com%2ftarget%2f1008070000002m9pu6792.jpg&ehk=zt4WPZ%2fgY14dXcP1sZ8XBIfl4wd9MePWvDv8dctW7Nc%3d&risl=&pid=ImgRaw&r=0","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"南京德基广场","longitude":"118.784902","latitude":"32.044077","des":"南京最高端的购物中心，看点是两个耗资800万和1200万的网红厕所","picURL":"https://p5.itc.cn/images01/20230411/b26e17093ca7493da6aff42b0ea1a927.jpeg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false}],[{"nameOfScence":"南京大屠杀遇难同胞纪念馆","longitude":"118.742372","latitude":"32.035217","des":"前事不忘后事之师。记得提前预约","picURL":"https://ts1.cn.mm.bing.net/th/id/R-C.014a2c43ffc39c7ec0f5f9ed3c4192df?rik=Vr4TGd87FIwgRg&pid=ImgRaw&r=0&sres=1&sresct=1","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"总统府","longitude":"118.797398","latitude":"32.044228","des":"中国近代建筑遗存中规模最大、保存最完整的建筑群，也是南京民国建筑的主要代表之一，中国近代历史的重要遗址。南京总统府自近代以来，多次成为中国政治军事的中枢、重大事件的策源地，中国一系列重大事件或在这里发生，与这里密切相关，许多重要人物都在此活动过，可顺道参观边上的1912街区","picURL":"https://tse2-mm.cn.bing.net/th/id/OIP-C.ymNloXeaPz84hzFdr-WVlgHaFj?pid=ImgDet&rs=1","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"科巷","longitude":"118.797356","latitude":"32.039277","des":"南京美食集中地，不怕排队的可以去","picURL":"https://tse4.mm.bing.net/th/id/OIP.8MapSu-RUy_vEDJP3kk1AAHaE8?rs=1&pid=ImgDetMain","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"先锋书店(五台山店)","longitude":"118.773518","latitude":"32.050837","des":"极具文艺气质的实体书店，开在半地下空间，占地面积超大，时不时会举办活动，分店很多，推荐五台山这家","picURL":"https://ts1.cn.mm.bing.net/th/id/R-C.0e2247490abd94f1605e8e9a7b746ca4?rik=QAJq4L0DkmPpmA&pid=ImgRaw&r=0","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"陶谷新村","longitude":"118.774846","latitude":"32.054315","des":"由居民区演变而来的文艺地标，面积不大，有很多的值得一逛的小店","picURL":"https://b0.bdstatic.com/74d10e9bd3fe93291af9c17dea016530.jpg@h_1280","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"老门东","longitude":"118.787631","latitude":"32.011682","des":"老门东因地处南京京城南门（即中华门）以东，故称“门东”，与老门西相对，是南京夫子庙秦淮风光带的重要组成部分。门东是南京传统民居聚集地，自古就是江南商贾云集、人文荟萃、世家大族居住之地。目前是一整片步行街区，晚间拍照尤其漂亮","picURL":"https://gimg2.baidu.com/image_search/src=http%3A%2F%2Fsafe-img.xhscdn.com%2Fbw1%2Fc719a1c8-1cc0-4b3b-85b6-a6644c0b003c%3FimageView2%2F2%2Fw%2F1080%2Fformat%2Fjpg&refer=http%3A%2F%2Fsafe-img.xhscdn.com&app=2002&size=f9999,10000&q=a80&n=0&g=0n&fmt=auto?sec=1700032811&t=6de23c950b1105e7b0fd6b1e9b797a71","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"夫子庙","longitude":"118.788876","latitude":"32.021485","des":"南京地标，地处夫子庙秦淮风光带核心区，尤其推荐晚上观赏桨声灯影里的秦淮河","picURL":"https://img.pconline.com.cn/images/upload/upc/tx/photoblog/1504/25/c18/5938541_1429973343124.jpg","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false}],[{"nameOfScence":"古鸡鸣寺","longitude":"118.795246","latitude":"32.061061","des":"鸡鸣寺已有一千七百多年的历史，是南京最古老的梵刹和皇家寺庙之一，香火一直旺盛不衰，自古有“南朝第一寺”，“南朝四百八十寺”之首的美誉，南朝时期与栖霞寺、定山寺齐名，是南朝时期中国的佛教中心。据说求姻缘比较准","picURL":"https://ts1.cn.mm.bing.net/th/id/R-C.54ab7a7f55d13a91de7d387cfb929d98?rik=%2fzmvtF3dpUzGvA&riu=http%3a%2f%2fimg1.qunarzz.com%2ftravel%2fd1%2f1608%2fc3%2f83534b6246d079b5.jpg_r_480x360x95_efc26141.jpg&ehk=UYgEjd1n2wl63x9ALx8VQ00J7rahskNrpF49KUND3tI%3d&risl=&pid=ImgRaw&r=0","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"颐和路民国时期公馆风貌区","longitude":"118.770087","latitude":"32.063981","des":"颐和路是中国拥有民国公馆最多的地区，被誉为“民国建筑博物馆” ","picURL":"https://tse4-mm.cn.bing.net/th/id/OIP-C.nG4eUpRAY4EB0Q8Tp6ly5gHaHa?pid=ImgDet&rs=1","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false},{"nameOfScence":"瞻园","longitude":"118.785163","latitude":"32.021034","des":"瞻园是南京现存历史最久的明代古典园林、“江南四大名园”之一。其历史可追溯至明太祖朱元璋称帝前的吴王府，后赐予中山王徐达的府邸花园，素以假山著称，以欧阳修诗“瞻望玉堂，如在天上”而命名，明代被称为“南都第一园”。园内布局典雅精致，有宏伟壮观的明清古建筑群，陡峭峻拔的假山，闻名遐迩的北宋太湖石，清幽素雅的楼榭亭台，奇峰叠嶂。瞻园中辟有太平天国历史博物馆，是中国唯一的太平天国专史博物馆。87年版《红楼梦》，赵雅芝版《新白娘子传奇》中的白府等便是在瞻园取景","picURL":"https://th.bing.com/th/id/R.d34137cd168eebdbef2d77755f70fae1?rik=4sR%2fLhLrMPHd0A&riu=http%3a%2f%2fn.sinaimg.cn%2fsinakd20200624ac%2f125%2fw2000h1325%2f20200624%2f35c2-ivmqpci5347453.jpg&ehk=%2bLJSmicSDxuo0LXgBMiABJpbUUZ4pWXKCTEBJE6sPiY%3d&risl=&pid=ImgRaw&r=0","pointOrNot":true,"contructor":"contructor","category":0,"done":false}]]}]
